headline: Last step of the routine: massage in until fully absorbed
subhead: Use after cleansing, toning and your serums, AM & PM, on face and neck.
proof_points: Boosted with Hyaluronic Acid & Betaine for multi-level hydration
footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 899 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person scene (person_prompt) is the human cue and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; real pack shot composited in the right 45%; rating line in the footnote band, CTA bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a bright off-white bathroom shelf wall with soft morning light from the upper left, a folded cream towel at the lower-left edge only. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: situation. The moment is the last step of the routine: F13 says to use it after cleansing, toning and all serums, and F14 gives AM & PM. Kept: in-use moment (Foxtale), a single use-moment headline (Chemist at Play). Dropped: timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo', and skin-repair, barrier and irritation wording (F2/F15/F18), plus the pregnancy line (F12). The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: in-use moment as the visual cue
headline that names one use moment

person_prompt: A woman in her mid-30s with a light-brown skin tone seated at a vanity by a window in the morning, wearing a plain white robe with a hairband holding her hair back, massaging a small amount of white cream into her cheek and jaw with her fingertips; soft daylight from the upper left, off-white wall with a faint warm-grey gradient, a plain folded towel on the surface beside her, shallow depth of field, calm expression, natural unretouched skin, nothing implying a result, framed so she sits slightly left of centre with calm space to her right. No jar, tub, tube, bottle or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

verdict.label: Ready for human review
verdict.detail: No blocking or must-fix issues found. This is a pre-screen, not an approval: brand and legal sign-off is still required.
